observations: Hindsight attempted to cache one missing adapter metadata entry on its read-only filesystem. The write was ignored; Hindsight became healthy, retained its data and served the subsequent core requests.
The final Eva1 cutover restart stopped gracefully in about 19 seconds, close to but below its 20-second TimeoutStopSec.
nonclaims: This is a full six-container cold start behind the proven A/B fallback, not a host or Docker-daemon reboot.
The managed durable-goal worker and native Telegram ingress remain inactive because no real durable-goal provider or non-conflicting Telegram credential is configured.
No external Telegram message was sent and no Home Assistant effect was executed.
